option_relations.rationale: Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO) is a broader category that can include CRVO with macular edema.

The leaf specifies 'Central retinal vein occlusion (CRVO) with macular edema', while the option specifies 'Macular retinal vein occlusion with chronic cystoid macular edema'. While both involve macular edema and retinal vein occlusion, the type of RVO (central vs. macular) and the chronicity/cystoid nature of the edema are not directly comparable or clearly related as supertype/subtype without further information.
Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO) is a distinct condition from Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO).
Retinal vein occlusion is a broad category that encompasses Central retinal vein occlusion (CRVO) with macular edema.
